verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents AI-generated writing around incidents: an automated post-mortem built from the incident timeline and Slack, and a Slack-native AI SRE agent, tagged with @betterstack, that investigates incidents. Neither is shown writing the incident live, and the post-mortem is produced after the fact. missing for 10: live running incident summaries, AI-drafted status-page/stakeholder updates, scribed call or bridge notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
